enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Extend arm. Pull blanket down slightly. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Stir. Lie still. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse off. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 1 while skimming the day's arts sector emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Place on counter. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread in toaster. Pour milk into glasses. Set table. Sit at table with Member 1. Eat breakfast. Pick up phone. Open email app. Scroll through emails. Read arts sector email. Reply to email. Put down phone. Finish breakfast. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag with sketchbook and laptop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and trousers. Put on shirt and trousers. Take out socks and shoes. Put on socks and shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up sketchbook and laptop. Place in bag. Pick up charger. Place in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts centre office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Step off bus. Walk to arts centre. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to office desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the arts centre office on program coordination, exhibition scheduling and grant paperwork
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open grant application form. Fill out form. Save form. Sign form. Place in folder. Open exhibition schedule spreadsheet. Update dates. Contact artists via email. Make phone calls. Attend meeting with curator. Discuss program. Take notes. Return to desk. Continue paperwork. File documents. Organize folders.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Walk to nearby park. Sit on bench. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Take out apple. Bite apple. Take out water bottle. Open cap. Drink water. Close cap. Put trash in bag. Stand up. Walk back to office. Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing arts administration work, meeting with artists and curators about upcoming projects
enriched_activities.desc: Open laptop. Review notes. Send email to artist. Call curator. Discuss project timeline. Take notes. Open project management software. Update tasks. Meet with artist. Show exhibition space. Discuss layout. Take photos. Return to desk. Update grant budget. Print revised budget. File documents. Attend team meeting. Present updates. Listen to feedback. Make notes. Return to desk. Check emails. Reply to urgent email. Organize desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the arts centre
enriched_activities.desc: Pack bag. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Step off. Walk home. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plates. Set table. Sit with Member 1. Eat dinner. Talk about day. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Walk to sink. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counters. Sweep floor. Put away leftovers in refrigerator. Wipe stove. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions on the computer, using the desk lamp and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press power button on computer. Open illustration software. Open commission file. Sketch rough draft. Use drawing tablet. Draw lines. Color. Add shading. Save file. Export image. Send to client. Check email. Reply to client. Open next commission. Take short break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue work. Save progress. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and chatting with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch show. Turn to Member 1. Ask about day. Listen. Comment on show. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch another show. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Continue watching. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Turn off TV.
Sit on sofa. Lean back. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Open eyes. Listen to music. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put down magazine. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and drinking a cup of herbal tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cupboard. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Turn on kettle. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour water into mug. Add honey. Stir. Pick up mug. Walk to living room. Sit down. Sip tea. Finish tea. Walk to kitchen. Rinse mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom 2. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Extend arm. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Stir. Lie still. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep.
